But have your laughs at our expense by all means.

You won't be able to for long.

But this carries the benefit that we can look around and see who is actually in the digital asset space for the ideas and for the value added to the global economy, not for our popularity or our bank roll.

@kurtwuckertjr @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon It's not a popularity contest.
